mechanism: Prochlorperazine may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing letrozole levels, while both drugs can cause dizziness and orthostatic hypotension through additive effects on the CNS and vasculature.
action: Monitor for increased letrozole side effects and orthostatic symptoms; consider alternative antiemetic if dizziness or hypotension develops; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical vigilance is warranted.
